snippet.title: Shipping Store Simulator 2037 - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The year is 2037. Your journey from humble pickup point to logistics center begins now! 
Hire robots, deliver packages via drone, and outshine your competitors. Drop off urgent shipments in your own truck at every corner of sunny Cranelock in Shipping Store Simulator 2037.

Whishlist the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4098030/Shipping_Store_Simulator_2037?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=revealtrailer

Learn more: https://say.games/games/shipping-store-simulator-2037
